title: SEC3: starttls_requested should be loop return value
description: In lifecycle.rs, run_command_loop signals the caller that STARTTLS was requested by setting ctx.starttls_requested = true then returning. This is an out-of-band side-channel on SessionContext rather than a return value. The flag is write-once from one code path, only meaningful for the window between loop exit and the caller checking it, and it persists on SessionContext for the entire post-upgrade session where it has no meaning. If a future caller of run_command_loop forgets to check the flag, the STARTTLS upgrade silently fails. A return enum (LoopExit { Done, StartTlsRequested }) would eliminate the flag from SessionContext entirely and make the control flow explicit. starttls_available is correctly on SessionContext and should stay. Tradeoff: requires changing run_command_loop signature and return type, touching two call sites.
